title: Powers of the General Constant
statement: For every real number $\eta>0$ and every integer $k\ge 0$, let $\rho(\eta)=\eta/(2+\eta)$ and $C(\eta)=(2/\eta+1)^{1+\eta}$. Then $C(\eta)^k=(\rho(\eta)^{-k})^{1+\eta}$.
